title: Digital Learning & AI Specialist
description:
Digital Learning & AI Specialist

Liverpool | Hybrid Working

Are you passionate about digital learning, AI and helping people embrace new technology? Have you worked with Microsoft 365 Copilot and enjoy turning complex technology into practical, engaging learning experiences?

We're working with a professional services organisation looking for a Digital Learning & AI Capability Specialist to help shape how employees learn, develop and adopt AI across the business.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine your Learning & Development expertise with emerging AI technologies, supporting digital transformation and helping colleagues work smarter.

What's on offer?

  • Opportunity to lead AI learning and Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption initiatives
  • Exposure to innovative learning technologies
  • A collaborative environment with the opportunity to influence digital learning strategy
  • The chance to make a genuine impact on how technology is adopted across the organisation

What you'll be doing:

  • Designing and delivering engaging digital learning programmes, workshops and resources
  • Supporting the adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI tools across the business
  • Developing AI literacy programmes, practical use cases and prompt libraries
  • Creating e-learning modules, videos, microlearning and digital learning pathways
  • Managing and improving learning management systems (LMS)
  • Working with stakeholders to identify learning needs and develop tailored solutions
  • Promoting responsible, ethical and effective AI use
  • Analysing learning engagement and adoption data to measure impact and improve programmes

What we're looking for:

  • Experience in Learning & Development, Digital Learning or Talent Development
  • Strong experience designing and delivering digital learning content
  • Practical knowledge of generative AI, ideally Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Confidence delivering workshops and explaining technology to non-technical audiences
  • Experience using LMS platforms and digital learning tools
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills
  • A proactive, creative approach to learning and continuous improvement
  • Experience with Articulate 360, Storyline or Rise would be advantageous
  • Professional services experience would be beneficial but isn't essential

If you're excited about combining digital learning with the rapidly evolving world of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of digital learning and AI adoption.

Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.


Due to the high volume of applications, if you haven’t heard from us within 2 working days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.
